notes: v1.0.70 - chunk-pipeline deep audit + FPS Boost 1.0.25: the async chunk decode apply read the target slot and called isValidChunk on it - on the rare case the slot was never installed (first-time chunk / view-ring pre-fill miss) existing was null, NPE, and 3 NPEs in 30s made the SafetyGate silently disable the whole async decode module (the ghost-failure pattern); a null/absent slot now simply installs the decoded chunk. The stale-mesh compile skip was gated on asyncChunkDecode, but the tuned chunk-build pool is used whenever the mod is active without Sodium (even with async decode OFF) - fast movement with decode off kept re-compiling stale sections and backlogged the mesh queue; the skip now matches the pool gate (active && !Sodium). applyReady no longer allocates a batch list every tick when the ready queue is empty (peek first).
